# LlamaNodes
> LlamaNodes provides public and premium blockchain RPC endpoints with advanced features, crypto payments, and no contracts.

LlamaNodes offers managed RPC infrastructure for multiple blockchain networks, including public and premium endpoints, developer tooling, and service information for teams integrating reliable node access.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://llamarpc.com/docs): Overview of LlamaNodes documentation, setup guidance, and product information.
- [Supported Chains](https://llamarpc.com/docs/supported-chains): List of blockchain networks available through LlamaNodes RPC infrastructure.
- [Getting Started](https://llamarpc.com/docs/getting-started): Introductory guide for connecting applications to LlamaNodes endpoints.
- [Authentication](https://llamarpc.com/docs/authentication): Explains API key usage and access patterns for protected RPC endpoints.
- [Rate Limits](https://llamarpc.com/docs/rate-limits): Details request limits, throughput expectations, and usage considerations.
- [Error Codes](https://llamarpc.com/docs/error-codes): Reference for common RPC and platform error responses.

## RPC Services
- [Public RPC](https://llamarpc.com/public-rpc): Public RPC offering for developers needing open blockchain endpoint access.
- [Premium RPC](https://llamarpc.com/premium-rpc): Dedicated and higher-performance RPC access with enhanced reliability and features.
- [Archive RPC](https://llamarpc.com/archive-rpc): Historical blockchain state access for indexing, analytics, and advanced queries.
- [Dedicated Nodes](https://llamarpc.com/dedicated-nodes): Private node infrastructure for teams requiring isolated blockchain access.
- [WebSocket RPC](https://llamarpc.com/websocket-rpc): Real-time blockchain event and subscription access over WebSocket connections.

## Supported Networks
- [Ethereum RPC](https://llamarpc.com/ethereum): RPC access for Ethereum mainnet applications and infrastructure workloads.
- [Arbitrum RPC](https://llamarpc.com/arbitrum): RPC endpoints for Arbitrum applications, transactions, and onchain data access.
- [Optimism RPC](https://llamarpc.com/optimism): RPC service for Optimism-based applications and developer integrations.
- [Polygon RPC](https://llamarpc.com/polygon): RPC endpoints for Polygon transactions, contracts, and data queries.
- [Base RPC](https://llamarpc.com/base): RPC access for Base ecosystem development and production workloads.
- [BNB Chain RPC](https://llamarpc.com/bnb-chain): RPC service for BNB Chain applications and smart contract interactions.
- [Avalanche RPC](https://llamarpc.com/avalanche): RPC endpoints for Avalanche C-Chain development and infrastructure use.
- [Solana RPC](https://llamarpc.com/solana): RPC access for Solana applications, transactions, and network data retrieval.

- [Choose Between Public and Premium RPC](https://llamarpc.com/docs/guides/public-vs-premium-rpc): Comparison of access tiers and recommended use cases.
- [Handle RPC Failures](https://llamarpc.com/docs/guides/handle-rpc-failures): Best practices for retries, failover, and resilient RPC integrations.
- [Optimize RPC Performance](https://llamarpc.com/docs/guides/optimize-rpc-performance): Recommendations for reducing latency and improving request efficiency.

## API Reference
- [JSON-RPC Methods](https://llamarpc.com/docs/api/json-rpc-methods): Reference for supported blockchain JSON-RPC method usage through LlamaNodes.
- [HTTP Endpoints](https://llamarpc.com/docs/api/http-endpoints): Describes HTTP endpoint structure, request formatting, and access patterns.
- [WebSocket Methods](https://llamarpc.com/docs/api/websocket-methods): Reference for subscription and event-driven RPC interactions over WebSocket.
- [API Keys](https://llamarpc.com/docs/api/api-keys): Details creating, managing, and using API keys with LlamaNodes services.
- [Usage Metrics](https://llamarpc.com/docs/api/usage-metrics): Explains available usage tracking and monitoring capabilities for accounts.
